verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. Leaving looks low-friction only by implication: stagewise works directly on local project folders, and its agent artifacts are plain Markdown files (WORKSPACE.md in .stagewise/, SKILL.md skills). The docs also describe it as open-source, and BYOK lets you skip the managed service entirely. missing for 10: an explicit data-export capability, export of chat/agent session history and settings in open formats, account-data export or deletion docs for the stagewise Account/Cloud, and any independent or hands-on confirmation of portability.
